settings.question: Is Brant Business Interiors an authorized Teknion dealer?
settings.answer: Yes. Brant Business Interiors is an authorized Teknion dealer serving Ontario. We specify, quote, deliver, and install Teknion contract furniture — workstations, demountable and architectural wall systems, and height-adjustable desking — for corporate and institutional workplaces, with delivery and installation by our own crew across the province.

settings.question: Is Brant Business Interiors an authorized Global Furniture Group dealer?
settings.answer: Yes. Brant Business Interiors is an authorized Global Furniture Group dealer in Ontario, carrying the full Global range — seating, desks, tables, and storage — plus the OTG (Offices to Go) value line and ObusForme ergonomic seating. We quote, deliver, and install across the province, with the manufacturer warranty supported locally.

settings.question: How do Global, Teknion, OTG, and ObusForme fit together?
settings.answer: Global, OTG, and ObusForme are all Global Furniture Group lines; Teknion is a separate, Feldberg-family-owned sister company to Global. Global is the flagship for chairs, desks, tables, and storage at commercial quality. Teknion is the premium-design sister brand for executive suites and high-design open-plan systems. OTG (Offices to Go), a division of Global Furniture Group, is the high-volume value line for institutional budgets. ObusForme covers the ergonomic-specialist niche. Finish palettes and engineering standards are coordinated across the Global lines, so mixing them within one project is straightforward.

settings.question: Do you stock GFG-family products or are they made to order?
settings.answer: Most GFG-family products are made to order against manufacturer lead times — typically 4 to 8 weeks depending on configuration and finish. Standard-finish, high-volume items such as task chairs, standard-depth desks, and basic lateral files can sometimes be sourced from distributor stock for faster delivery. Brant Business Interiors confirms the exact lead time on every quote.

settings.question: Can I spec across multiple Global Furniture Group and Teknion tiers in one project?
settings.answer: Yes — this is the typical institutional use case. Teknion for the executive offices and boardroom; Global for the open floor and shared meeting spaces; OTG for workhorse departmental seating and casegoods; ObusForme where ergonomic back-support is the priority. Brant Business Interiors consolidates the quote, design layout, delivery, and Ontario install across all tiers in a single project file.

settings.question: Are Global Furniture Group and Teknion products available under OECM?
settings.answer: Yes. All four brands — Global, Teknion, OTG, and ObusForme — are included in our OECM catalogue under Agreement 2025-470. Ontario institutional buyers can reference the agreement number on their purchase order and skip the open tender process. We include the OECM line item on every quote.
